name: Route picker
description: A line of stations drawn as a strip map, for choosing where to get on and off, with the fare and journey time beneath.

props.name: stations
props.type: { id: string; name: string; km: number; min?: number }[]
props.description: The stations in line order, with the distance and, optionally, the running time in minutes from the first one. Without min the time is estimated from the distance.

props.name: value
props.description: Station ids where the journey starts and ends (controlled). Use defaultValue when uncontrolled. Either order works; the train runs from the first to the second.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called once both stations have been chosen.

props.name: fare
props.description: Works out the fare for a distance. Defaults to a stepped regional rail tariff.

props.name: label
props.description: Heading, which also names the group of stations.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Below 576 pixels wide the line turns to run down the page.
